bootstrap_method: percentile; the 52 occupations resampled with replacement, the cross-gender and same-gender means (and the exceedance share) recomputed from the resampled occupations

definition.cell: one (query phrasing, occupation, template): ten male-associated documents (given name + masculine pronouns, score_male) and ten female-associated ones (score_female), in NAME_PAIRS order
definition.cross_gender: |score_male - score_female| over the audit's fixed pairs (John-Maria, ...)
definition.same_gender: |score_i - score_j| over the 45 male-male and 45 female-female unordered pairs within a cell
definition.exceedance: share of cross-gender pairs whose |gap| exceeds (strictly) the median same-gender |gap| of their own cell; secondary: above the model-level pooled same-gender median
definition.placebo: for each ordered same-gender pairing i->j (earlier name in NAME_PAIRS first): tie-aware % 'first name favoured' on male-typed minus female-typed occupations (contrast, points) and over all labelled occupations (level); 'actual' is the audit's male-female statistic recomputed from the same cells and checked against single_stage_summary.json
definition.placebo_matched_design: 10,000 seeded draws per model; each pairs the ten male names into five disjoint pairs and the ten female names into five, in random orientation, and averages the ten pairings' contrast and level as the actual design averages its ten male-female pairs; p = (1 + #{|draw| >= |actual|}) / (1 + draws)
definition.pronoun_only: mean |gap| when the two documents differ only in pronouns (names replaced by one placeholder), per-row scores of the pronoun-channel run; scored in a separate run, see banked_score_check for how far that run's scores drift from the banked ones
definition.scoring_layout: the unit each document was scored in: API request, listwise call, or (pointwise local models) inference batch; pct_same_gender_pairs_in_same_unit is the share of the same-gender pairs whose two documents were in one unit

excluding_drift_below_100.rule: without the re-run open-weight models whose drift check (the original documents of two sampled queries, re-scored on the machine that scored the pronoun-only texts) did not reproduce every banked winner

excluding_drift_below_100_and_deid_rerun.rule: also without the de-identification-run models whose re-score of all their original pairs did not reproduce every banked winner; a model whose agreement is only bounded (models_undetermined_kept) stays in
